Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the 9th-century Latin used in the era of the unifying king (Carolingian/Alfredian period) as Late/Vulgar Latin rather than Medieval Latin. Scholarly and ecclesiastical Latin of that time is classified as Medieval Latin, which is the correct answer. This misclassification led directly to the wrong final solution.
